statement: In Independence, Missouri, the sun sets about 5:06 p.m. on November 11, 2026, and about 4:56 p.m. by November 30.
The Army’s after-action review asks four questions: What was supposed to happen? What actually happened? Why was there a difference? What will we do differently next time?
leaderNote: From the leader guide. Wikipedia confirms the U.S. Army developed the after-action review, but the Army’s own guide (Training Circular 25-20) couldn’t be opened on 2026-11-04 to check the exact four questions. Secondary sources word the last one as “What will we keep or change?”
